title: Zhipu AI API Pricing 2026: Token Costs & Coding Plans
summary: Zhipu AI API pricing charges per-token for the GLM models or offers monthly Coding Plans at Lite, Pro and Max tiers.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


### Is the Zhipu AI API free to use?


Not as a general rule: paid usage is metered per token, though Zhipu has offered some lightweight Flash-tier models at no charge and has given new accounts trial credit. Treat free access as a prototyping allowance.


When a workload passes a test, it can still stall in production, because free models usually carry tighter rate limits. Check the vendor's pricing page for what's free on the day you read it.


### Is the Z.AI API compatible with the OpenAI SDK?


Yes, for chat completions: Z.ai exposes an OpenAI-style endpoint, so you can usually point the OpenAI client at its base URL, swap the key and change the model name. Compatibility covers the common request shape, not every feature.


Reasoning controls, tool-calling details and streaming of reasoning output can differ, so run your real prompts through it before committing. Don't assume a drop-in swap will bill the same, either: reasoning tokens still count as output.


### Do Zhipu prices differ outside China?


They can, because the vendor runs separate surfaces: the mainland platform (BigModel) and the international one (Z.ai). They list in different currencies and may not offer the same models, plans or promotions on the same day.


Price against the platform your account is registered on, not against a figure copied from the other one. A comparison across the two is only valid if you convert currency and confirm both lists carry the same model.


### How do I stop a Zhipu workflow overspending?


Cap output first, since output-heavy reasoning is where the bill grows. Set an explicit maximum on output tokens per call, and where a model offers a switch for thinking, turn it off for tasks that don't need it.


Then bound retries, because an agent loop that re-sends a long context on every failure multiplies cost faster than any list price suggests.


Route bulk, non-urgent work through discounted channels where they exist.


Finally, track spend per workflow rather than per account, so one runaway job is visible before the invoice arrives. If your usage is steady and coding-heavy, compare a subscription plan against metered billing, as the earlier sections lay out.


### How often does Zhipu change its prices?


Often enough that a price you saved last quarter shouldn't be trusted. Changes tend to arrive alongside new model releases, new tiers or promotional periods, and the vendor doesn't promise a fixed schedule.


Record the date next to every price in your cost model, and re-check the official pricing page before each budget review or contract renewal.


Build your estimates so that a shift in output price, the line that matters most, is a single parameter you can change rather than a rewrite.
